trajectory.development: Book 24 (Working Book text): the labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule, and a generation that refuses to be counted is asked to give back the water before it is owed. The Special Draw Right's review point falls here, and the Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage. The Book exports a public capability record, separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance. Attribution is largely agent_proposed (E5, E7).
trajectory.becomes_available: Book 20's Special Draw Right (E1), under which lineage crews carry channel repair, makes this possible: the generation raised after Book 20 has never seen the labour (E6), and the Right's condition can now be tested at its review point (E7).
trajectory.changes: The Right moves from a settled arrangement to a condition under review, and the uncounted generation is asked to give back before it is owed, where the labour had been left to lineage crews (E1, E5).

trajectory.development: Apprentices from outside the lineage are trained under the Right's condition, and the generation that came of age after Book 20 is brought into the labour, held to the lineage's craft standard. Conditional proposal; the trajectory names no new people, places or factions.
trajectory.becomes_available: Once the review point exposes the Right's condition (E3, E7), training outside the lineage is the route that condition points to. The lineages' concern for craft standards and fear of dilution (E3, an agent inference) shapes how that training is held.
trajectory.changes: The labour lineage crews kept under the Right (E1) is shared with people it had not reached, so craft standards and uncounted practice (E4) meet in the same work. The Right's condition becomes a means of entry, not only a test.

trajectory.development: The public capability record exported by Book 24 (E5) is used to show who can repair, kept separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance, so that repair is shown as capability. Conditional proposal. The excerpt does not say the record bears on the count.
trajectory.becomes_available: The export in Book 24 (E5) gives a record that can show who can repair, and the split between counted and uncounted practice (E4) gives it something to show. Neither is a route on its own (inferred from E4 and E5).
trajectory.changes: Book 24's labour is read as capability as well as obligation, so lineage repair (E1) and the apprentice route (stage 2) can appear in one record. The count question stays open because the record's wording does not remove it.

trajectory.development: The cohort that now practises both counted and uncounted return may claim standing in how the valley coordinates channel work. Conditional on stage 2. E8 is hypothetical and names no body that would grant standing, so the grantor is an open choice for a later Book.
trajectory.becomes_available: The practice E8 names as the basis for standing is what stage 2's route into labour would supply (E8, E4). No grantor is recorded, so standing becomes available only once a body is chosen.
trajectory.changes: Counted and uncounted return becomes a basis for shared coordination of channel work, which Book 24 does not yet provide for. The record of repairers (stage 3) becomes a possible input, though it names no coordinating role.

relations.reason: Book 24's labour gap depends on lineage crews carrying channel repair under the Right from Book 20, and its review point tests the Right's condition.

Book 24's review point exposes the Right's condition, and training outside the lineage is the route that condition points to. The review point is agent-proposed and the source gives a reversal for it.
Book 24 exports the public capability record, so its later use cannot occur before that export.
Stage 2 puts the uncounted generation to labour while the record is kept separate from the count. Whether that labour bridges the counted and uncounted split is not settled by the record.
E8 ties the possible standing to the cohort practising both counted and uncounted return. Stage 2 is the proposed route into that practice, and no other route is recorded.
A record of who can repair may help show who is fit to coordinate channel work, but the record names no coordinating role, so the help is indirect.

alternative_paths.ordering: Stop at Book 24: no proposed stage follows, and the record is exported without being used for repair.
alternative_paths.effect: Book 24 makes sense on its own: the labour gap, the conditional Right and the record are each stated in its text (E5, E7). The cohort split (E4) stays unresolved and no grantor of standing is named. Viable as a complete reading of the existing Books.

alternative_paths.ordering: Record before training: the public record is used to show who can repair (stage 3) before apprentices from outside the lineage are trained (stage 2).
alternative_paths.effect: The record would name only those who can repair now, which under E1 are lineage crews and households that meet the rota, so the uncounted generation would not yet appear in it (E6). This reinforces the current arrangement, and the record does not settle the count.

alternative_paths.ordering: Standing without training: the cohort claims standing (stage 4) without the apprentice route (stage 2).
alternative_paths.effect: E8 ties the possible standing to the cohort now practising both counted and uncounted return, which stage 2 is the only recorded route to supply. Without that route the standing has no stated basis and no grantor (E8). Closed on the current record.

opportunities.text: Read together, the Right's condition (E7) and the public record (E5) could make training outside the lineage visible as capability, which neither does alone: the condition is held inside the lineage, and the record names who can repair without a stated route to becoming one. This is a reading of two records, not a recorded plan.

The record is separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance (E5), so counted and uncounted practice (E4) could both be shown in it without either being converted into a debt or a count. The excerpt does not say that it does this, so the opportunity depends on the full wording of E5.

reader_experience: Book 24 reads as a demand on people. The labour lineage crews carried under the Right is asked back from a generation that has never seen it and refuses to be counted, and the Right's condition is tested at its review point. Read alone, Book 24 closes on a new public record and an open count, and it makes sense without the later stages. The proposed stages, if chosen, extend what it raises.
open_decisions: Whether Book 25 is to carry a development of its own; as recorded it repeats five of Book 24's elements word for word (E14).
Whether the Right's review point stays in Book 24, since the source gives a reversal for it and the point is agent-proposed (E7).
Who, if anyone, grants the cohort standing in channel coordination; E8 names no body and creates none.
Whether the uncounted generation's repair is meant to bear on the count at all; the excerpted record does not say (E5).
uncertainty: E5 is truncated mid-sentence after 'rather than who', so the record's full wording and its bearing on the count cannot be checked from this request.
Book 24 text is largely agent_proposed or asserted (E3, E5, E7); stage 1 rests on Working Book text and is not an applied or canonical revision.
Only one development (d1) is supplied. Books 9-11 and Book 20 are cited only through E1 and E6, so earlier history is not verified here.

criticism_assessments.reason: E14 shows Book 25's five citing elements (E9 to E13) match Book 24's E3 to E7 word for word, with matching source hashes, and no Book 25 development is recorded. Book 25 is dropped as a stage.

The visible wording of E5 says the record shows who can repair, rather than who, and does not say it removes the count, so the earlier claim read too much into it. E5 is truncated, so the count question stays unresolved until its full wording is read.

changes_from_prior: Book 25 is dropped as a stage (c1). Stages are renumbered s1 to s4: prior s3, s4 and s5 are now s2, s3 and s4, and the cohort-standing stage stays conditional on the apprentice stage.
The public record stage no longer says repair is recorded as capability rather than as count. It states only the record's stated purpose and leaves the count open (c2).
A complicates relation between the apprentice route and the record is added, because the count question now bears on both.
